arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
echo LEADS_SAFE_DEPLOY_PREPARATION_BEGIN
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json,re,tarfile
base=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
for rel in ('scripts/safe_runtime.py','scripts/organic_growth.py','scripts/leads_operational_report.py','main.py','ecosystem.config.js'):
 p=base/rel
 print('INSTALLED_FILE',rel,'exists',p.is_file(),'sha256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() else '-')
print('INSTALLED_DEPLOY_TOOL_EXISTS',(base/'scripts/deploy_project_only.py').is_file())
p=base/'scripts/deploy_project_only.py'
if p.is_file():
 lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 print('DEPLOY_TOOL_LINES',len(lines))
 for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
  if i<=22 or (re.search(r'(add_argument|ArgumentParser|--dry-run|--ref|--repo|--sha|--target|--backup|restart|rollback|pm2|version|archive)',l,re.I) and not re.search(r'(token|secret|phone|password|api_hash)',l,re.I)):
   print('DEPLOY_TOOL_LINE',i,l[:180])
p=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl')
print('EVENT_JOURNAL_EXISTS',p.is_file())
if p.is_file():
 keys=Counter(); labels=Counter(); total=0; invalid=0; with_member_id=0; first_ts=None; last_ts=None
 for raw in p.open(errors='replace'):
  total+=1
  try: obj=json.loads(raw)
  except Exception:invalid+=1;continue
  if not isinstance(obj,dict):continue
  keys.update(obj.keys())
  if any(x in obj for x in ('member_id','user_id','target_user_id','participant_id')):with_member_id+=1
  for k in ('event_type','event','action','status','kind'):
   v=obj.get(k)
   if isinstance(v,str) and len(v)<50:labels[(k,v)]+=1
  for k in ('ts','timestamp','created_at','occurred_at'):
   v=obj.get(k)
   if isinstance(v,str) and len(v)<60:
    if first_ts is None:first_ts=v
    last_ts=v
    break
 print('JOURNAL_LINES',total,'INVALID',invalid,'WITH_ID_FIELD',with_member_id)
 print('JOURNAL_KEYS',keys.most_common(28))
 print('JOURNAL_CATEGORIES',labels.most_common(30))
 print('JOURNAL_FIRST_LAST_TS',first_ts,last_ts)
for tgz in sorted(base.glob('.telegram-leads-release*.tgz')):
 try:
  with tarfile.open(tgz,'r:gz') as arc:
   names=[re.sub(r'\d{5,}','[id]',m.name) for m in arc.getmembers() if m.isfile()]
   matches=[n for n in names if any(x in n.lower() for x in ('state','member','history','backup'))]
   print('ARCHIVE',tgz.name,'FILE_COUNT',len(names),'DATA_NAMES',matches[:18])
 except Exception as e:print('ARCHIVE_ERROR',tgz.name,type(e).__name__)
PY
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-compare-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = "9596a0687aeed20e03bcd1f91ae2ad6d830cd523"
for rel in scripts/safe_runtime.py scripts/organic_growth.py scripts/leads_operational_report.py main.py ecosystem.config.js; do
 newhash=$(sha256sum "$work/$rel" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
 oldhash=$(sudo -n sha256sum "/opt/telegram-robot-leads/$rel" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
 if [ "$oldhash" = "$newhash" ];then echo "DEPLOY_DIFF $rel MATCH";else echo "DEPLOY_DIFF $rel CHANGED";fi
done
echo LEADS_SAFE_DEPLOY_PREPARATION_PASS
